name: HIV-1 target-cell-limited model with antiretroviral therapy
description:
HIV-1 within-host viral dynamics.
The canonical three-equation target-cell-limited system.
Parameter values: 0 of 9 checked against the source; the rest are recalled or illustrative.
reference: Perelson AS, Neumann AU, Markowitz M, Leonard JM, Ho DD (1996). HIV-1 dynamics in vivo: virion clearance rate, infected cell life-span, and viral generation time. Science 271(5255):1582–1586

compartments.name: Tc
compartments.description: uninfected target cells (CD4+ T cells, per µL)

parameters.name: dT
parameters.description: natural death rate of uninfected target cells [illustrative] (per day)

parameters.name: delta
parameters.description: death rate of productively infected cells; the authors' estimate implies an infected-cell half-life of ≈1.6 days [unverified; 0.5/day is the value conventionall

parameters.name: p
parameters.description: virion production rate per infected cell [illustrative] (virions cell⁻¹ day⁻¹)

parameters.name: cV
parameters.description: virion clearance rate from plasma (c is reserved, hence cV) [unverified; 3.07/day is the value conventionally cited from this paper] (per day)

parameters.name: eps_rt
parameters.description: efficacy of a reverse-transcriptase inhibitor (blocks new infection) [illustrative] (dimensionless, 0–1)

parameters.name: eps_pi
parameters.description: efficacy of a protease inhibitor (blocks production of infectious virions) [illustrative] (dimensionless, 0–1)

variables.name: er
variables.description: effective RT-inhibitor efficacy at time t

variables.name: ep
variables.description: effective PI efficacy at time t

variables.name: R0v
variables.description: basic reproductive ratio of the virus within host
